query_construction: terms = the normalised text split on every character that is not a letter or digit; drop arxiv_stopwords and tokens shorter than 2 characters; de-duplicate keeping first occurrence. search_query = 'all:<t1> AND all:<t2> AND ...'.

addendum.question: Does joining the query words with OR instead of AND put more anchors in arXiv's top 50?
addendum.why: arXiv missed ASM-1d (35% of anchors in its top 50 for the keyword phrasing), and at least 7 of its 13 misses lack a query word in any form, so the AND construction excluded them before arXiv ranked anything (SPIKE-FINDINGS-M4.md 1d).
addendum.queries: The 20 P1 queries: 10 topics x keyword and natural_language. Terms are built exactly as query_construction.arxiv; search_query joins them with ' AND ' (the same-day control) or ' OR ' (the treatment). Every other parameter as sources.arxiv.search.params. 40 requests.
addendum.order: Seeded with stream '<seed>/A1': the 20 queries are shuffled, and within each query the order of AND and OR is shuffled.
addendum.pacing: pacing['export.arxiv.org']: 3 s from the previous response end, one connection. Retry-After and the host-stop rule apply as in pacing.
addendum.no_repeats: As rules: a failure is an outcome, and no A1 request is repeated.
addendum.measure: Per construction and phrasing: anchors in the top 10 and top 50 (definitions.anchor_match, using the ids P2 verified), results returned, the reported total, and the zero-result rate. Latency per construction is reported, comparable because both run in the same window, and is not a decision input.
addendum.decision_rule: Adopt OR iff, for the keyword phrasing, OR's top-50 anchor recall is >= 50% and strictly greater than the same-day AND's. Otherwise AND stays. If OR beats AND but is below 50%, AND stays and the gap is reported to the owner.
addendum.outputs: Responses to data/eval/discovery-pools-arxiv-a1.json.gz with a manifest (arXiv metadata, CC0); numbers under addendum_a1 in spike/results/19_discovery_analysis.json; a section in SPIKE-FINDINGS-M4.md. The spike's committed pools are not changed.
does_not_establish: Anchor recall counts 20 famous papers and is blind to precision; OR may return more off-topic papers, which only phase 8's judged set can measure.
ASM-1 is not recomputed: a construction chosen after the fact cannot pass a bar retroactively.
One alternative is tested, so the anchors choose between two constructions, not among many.

caveat: The pools reflect this protocol's query construction. If phase 2 changes it or the page size, the pools are re-recorded through the real adapters before any judging. Judgments attach to papers, not positions, so any already made carry over.
